title: Renewable synthetic crude oil to mitigate carbon emissions and fossil fuel dependency
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07428B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hidde Kolmeijer, Juan D. Medrano-García, Abhinandan Nabera, Gonzalo Guillén-Gosálbez
This study models the potential of synthetic crude oil, showing that by combining biomass, biogas, and air-captured CO2 it could achieve net-zero refineries at about 80 USD per barrel, while utilising existing infrastructure.
